title: Marriage Toxin
description: For centuries, the deadly arts have been perfected by Masters, and Five Great Families hold the greatest power and influence. Hikaru Gero, an heir to the Gero family, lives in the underworld as an elite assassin. When his sister is pressured to produce an heir, Hikaru asks Mei Kinosaki, a brilliant marriage swindler, to find him a bride. The most challenging mission of his life begins!

episodes.title: S1-E1The Poison Master's Search for a Bride

episodes_data.title: Marriage Toxin Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: An assassin must marry to appease his clan and save his sister. Small problem: He doesn't know how to date.

episodes_data.title: Marriage Toxin Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Kinosaki takes Gero to practice dating in a floating art museum that becomes the scene of a heist.

episodes_data.title: Marriage Toxin Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Gero fights a Water Master to rescue Himekawa, but his real challenge is taking her on a date afterward.

episodes_data.title: Marriage Toxin Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Gero goes undercover as a student to guard a corporate heiress, but he isn't the only Master on campus.

episodes_data.title: Marriage Toxin Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: A test of courage seems like a romantic opportunity, but it turns out to be a deadly trap.

episodes_data.title: Marriage Toxin Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Panicked students try to sacrifice Ureshino, and stopping Naruko is the only way to make them see reason.

episodes_data.title: Marriage Toxin Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Gero goes to see his friend get married, only to run into some particularly unwelcome wedding crashers.

episodes_data.title: Marriage Toxin Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Gero takes a job to protect a fellow Master from a man who can go toe-to-toe with the expert assassins.

episodes_data.title: Marriage Toxin Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: To save Arashiyama, Gero and friends storm into the Beast Clan's home ground.
